name: fence_straight_ns
note: North-south segment, post on the west and south of the 1×1 footprint. Two foreshortened 22 px log-top rails (EW log diameter) run north from the post, across the 32 px gap, and tuck into the next tile's post. 12 px overhang above the footprint. All posts 96 px, 1:1.
construction: Composited at 1:1 from the shared post and rail set (pilot fence_straight). No new generation.
